Singapore Punggol Digital District physical-AI testbed (2026-05): first large-scale multi-vendor robot trials (delivery/patrol/cleaning) in mixed-use public space under Active Mobility Act exemption — global precedent for embodied-AI on-street test field.
Singapore IMDA graduated-autonomy framework: supervision intensity scales with agent impact; human approval at critical nodes, offline on failure — governance backing for the Make-Way Rules.
EU AI Act agentic-governance gap: liability attribution, supervision paradox, cross-jurisdiction; robot safety elements compliance deferred to 2028 — context for global AI-governance voice.

Monash 2025 six-city study (HK/Seoul/Shanghai/Singapore/Taipei/Tokyo): even leading robot cities lack policies protecting public interest beyond safety; urges anticipatory, citizen-engaged policymaking — supports anti-surveillance/anti-displacement red lines.

Urban Robotics Foundation: liability/authority gap; proposal for machine-readable 'physical API' (curbs, crossings, signage) and cross-company incident database — backs the three-track physical segregation design.
